# x402 Case Converter

> Deterministic naming-case conversion for agents. Snake, camel, kebab, Pascal, CONSTANT, title and more. No accounts. Pay per call with x402 (USDC on Base).

## Paid Endpoint

- POST /api/convert
  - Input: `{ "text": "...", "to": "snake|camel|kebab|pascal|constant|title|lower|upper" }`
  - Output: `{ "success": true, "result": "...", "meta": {...} }`
  - Price: ~0.007 USDC

## Free Discovery

- GET /catalog
- GET / (service card)

## Why agents use it

- Zero variance, pure string transforms
- Token-cheap, high frequency safe
- Perfect for data cleaning, code generation pipelines, schema mapping
